✨ SinceEnchantments ✨

The Ultimate, Highly-Optimized RPG Custom Enchantment System for PaperMC

📚 DOCUMENTATION (WIKI) • 🎥 VIDEO SHOWCASE

--- ## 📖 Overview **SinceEnchantments** is a next-generation custom enchantment plugin designed to bring authentic MMORPG upgrade mechanics to your Minecraft server. Say goodbye to messy NBT tags and broken lore! Powered by **PacketEvents**, SinceEnchantments renders all enchantment visuals purely via packets. Your items remain fundamentally clean on the server side, while clients see beautiful, dynamically placed enchantment lore. ## 📺 Video Showcase ## ⭐ Core Features ### 📡 Packet-Rendered Lore (Zero Item Bloat) * **Virtual Rendering:** Enchantments are displayed via client-side packets. No permanent lore strings are written to the item, eliminating the "zero-width space" bugs and messy legacy formatting. * **Custom Positioning:** Place the `{enchants}` placeholder anywhere in your item's lore, and the plugin will seamlessly inject the enchantments exactly where you want them. ### 🎲 Deep RPG Upgrade Mechanics * **RNG System:** Every Enchantment Book comes with specific **Success** and **Destroy** rates. Will your players risk losing their gear for ultimate power? * **Slot Limits:** Balance your server economy! Limit the maximum number of custom enchantments an item can hold based on its material type. ### ⚔️ Seamless Compatibility * **MMOItems Integration:** Fully hooked into MMOItems. You can set specific enchantment whitelists and custom slot limits for individual MMOItem IDs. * **Vanilla Anvil Support:** Combine custom enchant books to level them up, or apply them directly to gear using Vanilla XP mechanics. ### 🧩 Addon & API System * Easily write your own custom enchantments! Developers can create standalone `.jar` addons and simply drop them into the `plugins/SinceEnchantments/Enchantments` folder. No messy hardcoding required. --- ## 💎 The Enchantment Ecosystem (Custom Items) SinceEnchantments introduces a balanced economy of upgrade items, fully customizable in `items.yml`: * 📙 **Enchantment Books:** The core upgrade item featuring dynamic levels, success rates, and destroy rates. * 🍀 **Success Charms:** Drag and drop these onto an Enchantment Book to increase its Success Rate (and decrease its Destroy Rate). A must-have for endgame crafting! * 💎 **Slot Gems:** Apply these to an item to increase (or decrease) its maximum enchantment capacity. * 📜 **Extractors:** Safely remove an enchantment from an item and turn it back into a book. Features two modes: * *Random:* Pulls a random enchantment off the item. * *Specific:* Opens a modern, lag-free **Paper Dialog API** GUI, allowing players to choose exactly which enchantment to extract. * 🔥 **Purge Scrolls:** Cleanse an item of all custom enchantments instantly (with an admin option to refund the books). * 🔒 **Lock Scrolls:** Permanently lock an item, preventing any further enchantments, extractions, or modifications. --- ## 🚀 Getting Started Ready to revolutionize your server's gear progression? 👉 **[Read the Official Wiki for Setup & Configuration Guides](https://gitlab.com/sincerpg/SinceEnchantments/-/wikis/Home)**
